content:
We need number of carbonyl (C=O) groups. IR spectrum shows a peak at 1737 cm-1 typical for carbonyl stretch. Only one such peak. Could be multiple carbonyls overlapping but likely one. No other carbonyl peaks (e.g., around 1700-1750). So answer 1.

We could also check carbon NMR for carbonyl carbons (~190-210 ppm). But IR already indicates one carbonyl. To be safe, maybe check carbon NMR. Use carbon_nmr_spectra.
